**Summary:**

I resolved ticket T-3005 by identifying and diagnosing the root cause of the nightly report generator pod failures. The pods were being evicted mid-run due to lack of ephemeral storage resource allocation—the containers were consuming ~39-40 GiB but had no ephemeral-storage limits or requests defined in their pod spec. I provided the ticket owner with a specific fix: add ephemeral-storage requests and limits (40Gi request, 50Gi limit) to the report-generator Deployment configuration to prevent future evictions during the nightly build process.
